card.name: Pre- before attached, filled, loaded
card.fires_on: The word "pre" (as in pre-filled, pre-attached, pre-loaded) right after a device noun such as needle, syringe, inserter or applicator in handling instructions.

modes.label: Pre- before device state
modes.description: The prefix "pre" joins a later word like attached, filled, loaded or positioned, describing a device part supplied ready to use.
modes.example: Each PLEGRIDY pen and syringe for subcutaneous injection is provided with the needle<< pre>>-attached.

modes.label: Pre- in hardware descriptions
modes.description: The same prefix appears in electronics text, for example a board that comes pre-burned with software.
